Alright, let me think through this year carefully. I've got 225 mu to manage — that's a serious operation, not something our family of four can handle alone. My wife and I do the core work, and we hire seasonal labor for the busy windows. Four years in, I'm still learning, but I did vocational training and I keep notes on each field's performance, so I try to be systematic about this.

Here's how I'm thinking about it:

**Land allocation.** I'm splitting the farm between wheat-maize double crop (165 mu) and cotton single crop (60 mu). The wheat-maize system is the workhorse — stable yields, government supports the wheat price, and I've got two crops of revenue per year. Cotton is on my 60 mu of lighter-textured fields where wheat-maize doesn't do as well; prices have been okay and the lint quality from Quzhou gets a decent premium.

**Wheat (already in the ground since last October).** The wheat was planted mid-October with Jimai 22 — it's been the reliable variety around here. At this point (late April), it's heading out. I already put down compound fertilizer as base (about 40 kg/mu of 15-15-15) at planting. My topdress plan is 10 kg urea/mu at jointing, which I did last month, and I'm watching now to see if I need another light topdress at booting. I'm targeting ~500 kg/mu — my best field hit 540 last year, my worst was 420, so 500 feels right for the farm average.

**Maize (planting mid-June right after wheat harvest).** Tight turnaround — I've booked the combine for June 10-12 window and the planter crew follows within three days. Using Zhengdan 958, which my neighbors and I have all had good luck with. I'll put controlled-release urea blend at planting (about 30 kg/mu of 28-8-8) and topdress another 8 kg urea at V6-V8 if the plants look like they need it. Irrigation depends on July rain — usually I do 1-2 turns.

**Cotton (planting now, late April).** Already prepped the fields. Going with a local Bt variety for bollworm resistance. Cotton is the one crop I'm still most uncertain on — my yields have been inconsistent (220-310 kg lint/mu range). Fertilizer I split across base, early bloom, and peak bloom. Plant growth regulator is essential, and I'll probably spray 5-6 times for insects through the season.

**Budget reality.** I'm running this on input credit from the ag supply cooperative — total input spend around 180,000 yuan across the farm. I keep a cash buffer because pesticide emergencies on cotton can hit fast.
